newsitem.title: USA: Plymouth Rubber to take $1 mln charge.
newsitem.headline: Plymouth Rubber to take $1 mln charge.

text.p: Plymouth Rubber Co Inc said Wednesday it will freeze the company's non-contributory defined benefit pension plan as of November 30, a move that will result in a net charge of $1 million.
The freeze will not affect benefits already earned by current and former employees, but will eliminate about $100,000 now spent each year to fund new layers of benefits, the company said.
The company said the retirement and savings needs of its employees will be better served by its 401k Plan.

The company said amortization associated with the move will be accomplished in the quarter ending August 30 by a non-cash charge to operating income of about $1.6 million, offset in part by a credit to taxes of about $600,000, resulting in a net charge of approximately $1 million.
